title: Agentic Video Understanding: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2609.31713v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become capable of processing increasingly diverse modalities and longer temporal contexts, an emerging line of work is moving beyond fixed video-language inference toward agentic systems that actively decide what information to inspect, retain, verify, and act upon. This survey reviews video understanding agents: systems that use video as the primary information source and solve understanding tasks through adaptive state construction and action selection. We first formalize an agent loop for video understanding, then address a central question: why do agents matter for video understanding? To answer this, we organize the literature through a challenge-to-design taxonomy, linking context bottlenecks to hierarchical evidence memory, evidence sparsity to active evidence acquisition, temporal causality to state and process tracking, and multimodal ambiguity to role-specialized coordination. translated_title: 智能体化视频理解：综述
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）能够处理日益多样化的模态和更长的时间上下文，一条新兴的研究路线正从固定的视频-语言推理转向智能体系统——这类系统能够主动决定检查、保留、验证哪些信息并据此采取行动。本综述回顾了视频理解智能体：即以视频为主要信息源，通过自适应状态构建和动作选择来解决理解任务的系统。我们首先对视频理解的智能体循环进行了形式化，然后探讨一个核心问题：为什么智能体对视频理解至关重要？为回答这一问题，我们通过“挑战到设计”的分类体系组织相关文献，将上下文瓶颈与分层证据记忆、证据稀疏性与主动证据获取、时序因果性与状态及过程追踪、多模态歧义性与角色专门化协同逐一关联起来。
tldr: 本综述首次对视频理解智能体循环进行了形式化定义，并提出了“挑战到设计”的分类框架，将上下文瓶颈、证据稀疏性、时序因果性和多模态歧义四大核心挑战与分层证据记忆、主动证据获取、状态过程追踪、角色专门化协同四类设计方案一一对应。
en_tdlr: This survey formalizes the agent loop for video understanding and organizes the literature through a challenge-to-design taxonomy that maps four core challenges—context bottlenecks, evidence sparsity, temporal causality, and multimodal ambiguity—to corresponding design solutions including hierarchical evidence memory, active evidence acquisition, state and process tracking, and role-specialized coordination.
